Drag the camera, then tap Add panel. Choose a new Beat for each story moment.
Select a panel, then tap Move earlier or Move later. Tap a marker to inspect a cut.
Tap Play to watch from the start, or From panel to start at the selected panel.
The board has twelve panels. Select a panel to revise it, or delete one to make room.
Tap Stop to hold this frame. Step and Back move one panel at a time.
Tap a marker, then Go to panel to repair the cut. Scroll for more panels; My board returns to your work.
Your cuts have no continuity markers. Tap Animatic, then Play to watch the timing.
Use arrow keys to move the camera a quarter meter. Hold Shift to move one meter.
Choose Beat to cover another script moment, then tap Add panel for the next shot.
Select a panel, then tap Move earlier to change the order. Tap a marker to inspect a cut.
Select a panel, then tap Move later to change the order. Tap a marker to inspect a cut.

Camera stopped: keep 0.3 m clear of the table and characters. Drag around them.
Crossing the line flips who is on the left. The audience can lose track of where people are. A neutral shot in between lets you cross.
Two very similar shots in a row look like a glitch. Change the angle by 30 degrees or more, or change the shot size by two steps.
